title: "Invalid topic name" and "node name must not contain characters other than alphanumerics or '_'" in ROS 2: dashes, leading digits, empty names, ~ and length limits, measured
excerpt: Which topic, node, namespace and service names ROS 2 rejects and why: dashes, tokens starting with a digit, empty names, ~ without a slash, the 247-character topic limit and the 220-character node limit. rclpy, rclcpp, ros2 CLI and launch on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
